exposure: companion support actions (emotional, physical, informational, intermediation)
outcome: types and frequency of support actions provided by companions during labor, birth, and postpartum
cohort: This study included 1,147 companions of women giving birth at three public maternity hospitals.
finding: Companions actively participated in the birth process, providing all four types of support, with emotional support being the most frequent, followed by physical and informational support, mainly during labor and birth.
